items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Willie calls me and wants me to do it with him... I went to Canada with Willie Lion Smith.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so Willie the Lion Smith, he got him to be the leader. So anyway, so now Willie calls me and wants me to do it with him. I said okay. So now they're going to do it for scale, for union scale. All right.

So they come to my office on 48th Street to make a rehearsal. And in rehearsal Willie and George got into -- George Avakian -- got into a fight. And Willie walked out. So he ran on out, and George followed him out. Five minutes later George came back, says, Willie's quit. Would you take it? I said okay.
